title: Feature Request: Leak detection
symptom: The user reports that one of the biggest issues with pods is occlusions and leakage, and requests a way to identify a leak by too little pressure. They describe an experience where their blood glucose went high after multiple boluses, suspecting they were not getting all their insulin.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive cause. A maintainer suggests it is close to impossible to distinguish between sensitivity change, forgotten bolus, leaking infusion set, etc. within a reasonable period. Another comment notes that the pressure value is not sent outside the pump.
evidence_quote: I believe it's close to impossible distinguish between sensitivity change, forgotten bolus, leaking infusion set etc within reasonable period of time
